parameters: The time for subtle measures has passed. Tidereavers, our objective is Fort Naxos. Surround that Fortress and have no mercy.
They sent Kuroda?! Hell's bells, they're not messin' around. That guy's got killing in his blood.\! \n[8], some powerful folks want your hide.
\n[8], we could use your knowledge here.
...The Temple needs *my* advice? I hardly think...
The Temple is not accustomed to the open battlefield.
Okay...\| well, we're outnumbered. The standard move is to secure a defensive bottleneck.\! We might try to take the small forts by the river. It's slightly better than being overwhelmed here.
Right. We will follow your command, \n[8]. Donar be with us.
Looks like we're right on time.\! \n[8], don't count us out just yet.
The Army's going to have our heads if they find out about this!\! Are you sure you're okay with this, guys?!
I've never known \n[8] to be sinister in any way.\! There's something fishy going on and \n[8] needs our help!
That's very gutsy of you, Jules...
We're way past worryin' about the Army now, kiddos, we're criminals now.\! But no time for belly achin'. Let's get our butts over to \n[8]'s position on the double!
Dear brother!\! Oh my stars... I cannot describe how relieved I am to see you here!
You too, Abi.\! I'm so proud of you - the Temple seems to have you doing some important tasks now!
Yes... it is very challenging, but this is what I wanted.\! But... surely you were not sent here by your leaders...\| Oh, Jules, what have you done?\! You are always giving yourself up for others.
Yeah, yeah, I guess so.\! But now I'm with you, so it can't be all that bad, right?
Some day you'll live for you and no one else, Jules...
Aw, don't worry about me.\! Let's just get through this battle in one piece, Abi!
I will not throw away my life for this employer, for this mission...
